scientific_methodology_analysis.noul_primitive_interpretation: A noul score of 0.81 indicated high system readiness and minimal residual ambiguity following the deterministic repair of hypotheses H01, H02, H03, and H05, approving the low-cost 16-sample GPU smoke run.
scientific_methodology_analysis.choice_primitive_interpretation: Jev System One assigned 88% probability to prioritizing the unadapted Base model ('base') over adapter configurations ('arm5', 'arm4'). This recommendation proved scientifically critical: establishing the unadapted baseline anchor was essential to uncover the severe pre-training slot position bias (Base choosing 'a' across rotations), without which Arm 5's entity tracking gain could not be accurately isolated.
